about: Particles in a box moving by simple rules, bouncing off the walls, faster or slower as their speed changes on a word, and a wall that can lift so they spread with a count on each side: gases and heat, diffusion, random motion, crowds mixing.

speeds.about: speeds in turn, split by commas; 1 is gentle, 3 is hot

start.about: all to start spread through the box, left to start in its left half behind a wall

wall.about: 1 puts a wall down the middle that lifts on its moment, with a count on each side

when.about: moments each speed change begins, then the moment the wall lifts; else spread out
